site.description: MODERNFLEX is an independent culture platform covering fashion, music, art, photography, pop culture and creative tech. Worldwide, based in Bristol.
site.footer: Independent culture platform. Online since 2017, now based in Bristol.
site.smallprint: The stories, names and episodes currently on the site are samples showing how it works.

editorial.intro: Global culture with a point of view: the stories everyone is talking about, and the ones happening on our doorstep. Fashion, music, art, photography, pop culture and creative tech.

mftv.tagline: Candid, cinematic, filmed in Bristol first.
mftv.home_tagline: Modernflex TV. Starting on our own streets.

community.intro: MODERNFLEX is growing past the page. Our audience is everywhere; our first physical home is Bristol, where we can show up in person and build something real.
community.home_statement: More than a publication. A room full of people who make things, and people who want to find them.
